title: Tailoring for MetaHuman: CLO & Marvelous Designer to Unreal Engine Workflow Demonstration
description:

In this live stream co-hosted with Epic Games, we walked through the entire digital human clothing creation process: starting from scratch to “sculpt” a MetaHuman, customizing exclusive clothing using CLO & MD, and finally importing it into Unreal Engine for animation rendering.

In addition to the intensive hands-on practice, we also shared a series of stunning artworks at the beginning, giving you a direct experience of how these tools seamlessly integrate workflows, helping you easily achieve professional-level visual effects.

chunks.content: ## Introduction to Tailoring for MetaHuman Workflow This section introduces the collaborative webinar involving CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Unreal Engine focused on creating tailored MetaHumans. It covers the roles of the presenters and sets the context for the demonstration of the full pipeline from MetaHuman creation to garment design and animation within Unreal Engine. - The webinar is the first collaborative event featuring CLO and Unreal Engine. - Presenters include Ariel (3D apparel designer at CLO), Billy (3D artist at Marvelous Designer), Kami (senior technical artist at Epic focusing on MetaHumans), and another Kami (lead clothing artist at Epic Games). - The session includes live Q&A and previews an upcoming contest related to the demonstrated workflows. - Early showcase of artwork created using CLO, Marvelous Designer, MetaHuman, and Unreal Engine highlights the creative potential of the pipeline. --- ## Showcasing MetaHuman and Digital Clothing Art This section presents examples of digital clothing and avatars created with the MetaHuman system and CLO/Marvelous Designer tools, illustrating the artistic possibilities and technical achievements in cloth simulation and rendering. - Holo boxes presented at an Epic, CLO, and Unreal event in London featured life-size digital avatars with dynamic cloth simulation. - Artists utilize MetaHumans to create unique, stylized avatars with high personality and storytelling elements. - The evolution from simple video game clothing to highly detailed, animated garments with realistic beadwork and fabric movement is emphasized. - Examples include ethereal clothing rendered with detailed lighting and atmosphere in Unreal Engine. - Some artists integrate physical clothing designs with digital assets, demonstrating a full-circle workflow from real-world garments to digital animation. - The showcased works underscore the power of Unreal Engine’s rendering capabilities to bring digital clothing and avatars to life in cinematic quality. --- ## MetaHuman Creation and Customization in Unreal Engine This section details the process of creating and customizing MetaHumans using Unreal Engine’s MetaHuman Creator, focusing on facial and body customization, preset usage, and preparing characters for clothing design in CLO. - MetaHumans are highly customizable, photorealistic avatars natively integrated into Unreal Engine with built-in animation and real-time webcam support. - MetaHuman Creator interface allows switching between different visual modes (topology, skin, clay) and lighting scenarios. - Facial customization includes blend mode (morphing between presets), layer mode (moving specific facial points), asymmetry toggling, and detailed sculpting with point creation. - Teeth, eyelashes, and other facial features have adjustable sliders for variation. - Preset faces and bodies are available for quick selection or further modification. - Body customization includes global parameters (masculine, feminine, muscularity, fat, height) and detailed individual measurements in centimeters. - Users can import external bodies with MetaHuman topology for precise conforming to custom shapes. - The head scale parameter controls the relative size of the head to the body. - Hair and facial hair are selectable from MetaHuman Creator’s built-in library or imported groom assets (e.g., from Epic’s free downloads on Fab). - Materials such as skin tone, freckles, eye color, and makeup are adjustable.
